name: @gjsify/react-native
description: The React Native view vocabulary rendered onto GTK4/Adwaita, over @gjsify/gtk-host

scripts.clear: gjsify clear lib tmp tsconfig.tsbuildinfo test.gjs.mjs
scripts.build: gjsify run build:gjsify && gjsify run build:types
scripts.build:test:gjs: gjsify build src/test.mts --app gjs --outfile test.gjs.mjs --define "process.env.NODE_ENV='production'" --exclude-globals navigator
scripts.build:test:node: gjsify build src/test.mts --app node --outfile dist/test.node.mjs --define "process.env.NODE_ENV='production'" --exclude-globals navigator
scripts.test: gjsify run build:gjsify && gjsify run build:test && gjsify run test:gjs
scripts.test:gjs-on-node: gjsify run build:gjsify && gjsify run build:test:node && node dist/test.node.mjs

osNotes.darwin: Platform.OS reads the host OS, so this package owes an OS claim (ADR 0018). MEASURED 2026-08-31 by gtk-os-suites.yml on darwin-arm64 (macOS 26.5.2) and darwin-x64 (macOS 15.7.9), on Node against the published @gjsify/gtk-runtime-darwin-* closure with no Homebrew GTK on the host — the combination ADR 0024 § 4 puts a shipped .app on. The layer this package renders through, @gjsify/gtk-host, is GATING and green there: 2274 of 2274 on both arches. Its OWN suite ran as a probe and reported 2 of 857 on each arch — BY NAME the same two that failed on Linux under the node target (#1438), so darwin added nothing to that set. #1438 is now CLOSED in the engine — node-gi realizes a classed GType on the `$gtype` read and runs a class-struct static on the class it was CALLED on — and the Linux node leg measures 1222 of 1222. This leg does NOT yet, and the reason is the pairing rather than the operating system: the fix is in the addon's C++, and gtk-os-suites.yml installs the PUBLISHED `@gjsify/node-gi` prebuild here on purpose (ADR 0024 § 4 asks what a stranger's download does). MEASURED at the same commit on 2026-09-02: 1 of 1220 on both darwin arches against 1222 of 1222 on Linux with a locally built addon — the same `popped` assertion, the one #1438 fixed. So the step stays a probe and this claim stays `partial` until the first release carrying that engine fix; promote on the first run after it where the only failures left are darwin's own. Nothing else is known to stand in the way: the widgets are GTK4/Adwaita and the style partition is pure TS.
osNotes.win32: As darwin for why a claim is owed, and one step further: there is no GJS host on Windows at all (ADR 0024 § 4), so the only route is Node + @gjsify/node-gi + @gjsify/gtk-runtime-win32-x64 — which gtk-os-suites.yml installs from npm and MEASURED on 2026-08-31. The closure is sound and GATING: the published bundle verifies (33 backed typelibs, windowing=true, decode probe) and check-batteries.mjs loads Gtk + Adw with no gvsbuild GTK on the host. The suite reported 7 of 848 — and that NUMBER is the misleading part, so here is its attribution: 2 were the #1438 baseline that was red on every OS and 1 a knock-on of one of them (the same `popped` seam), all three CLOSED in the engine since — and still counted on this leg, which runs the PUBLISHED addon and so cannot see an unreleased C++ fix (measured, same as darwin, 2026-09-02); 2 are inherited from @gjsify/gtk-host's table declaring GTK's Unix print stack (#1446, and gtk-host itself is 6 of 2264 there against 2274/2274 on both darwin arches), and 2 were POSIX-shaped ASSERTIONS rather than defects — the Image/ImageBackground vectors round-tripped '/nonexistent-gjsify-vector.png' through Gio.File.new_for_path (src/components.ts) and asserted get_path() returned it unchanged, but get_path() answers the NATIVE path, so GLib correctly returned '\\nonexistent-gjsify-vector.png'. FIXED in #1556: both now compare with Gio.File.equal plus the basename, which is the same claim in every separator. Fixing them found a real win32 defect beside them, also fixed there: normaliseSource read a DRIVE LETTER as a URI scheme (RFC 3986 admits a single ALPHA), so 'C:\\images\\logo.png' was refused as a 'c:' URI on the one OS that spells absolute paths that way. So this layer's own win32-specific defect count is ZERO, and `partial` records unmeasured ground rather than a Windows wall. Only win32-x64 is measurable at all — gvsbuild publishes no arm64 GTK. Promote when the engine fix for #1438 is released and #1446 closes; the assertions are no longer in the way.
